projects.title: The 6:15 platform

chapters.text: Six-fifteen. The platform is packed, everyone shoulder to shoulder, and your train is still two minutes out.
This is the moment an open tote turns into a worry. Phone, card, keys, everything sits right on top, one bump away from the floor.
So your card goes in the hidden pocket on the back. It sits flat against you, out of sight, and you never have to open the bag to reach it.
Your phone rides in a gold side zip. One pull, and it is in your hand. One more pull, and it is away again.
The doors open. You swing the strap across your body, and you step on with both hands free for the rail.
Back home. Your keys are right where you left them, in the other side zip, and the bag still looks as good as it did this morning.
